name: googlechat
label: Google Chat
description: Google Chat is a messaging app that allows you to send and receive messages, create spaces, and more.

sendAMessage.label: Send a Message
sendAMessage.description: Send a message to a space or direct conversation.

text.label: Message
text.description: The message content to send. Supports basic formatting like *bold*, _italic_, and @mentions.

thread.label: Thread
thread.description: Select a thread to reply to, leave empty for new thread

messageReplyOption.label: Reply Behavior
messageReplyOption.description: How to handle replies when thread ID is provided.

options.label: Reply only (fail if thread not found)

customMessageId.label: Custom Message ID
customMessageId.description: Optional unique ID for this message (auto-generated if empty). Useful for deduplication.

isPrivate.label: Send as Private Message
isPrivate.description: Send this message privately to a specific user. Requires app authentication.

privateMessageViewer.label: Private Message Recipient
privateMessageViewer.description: Select the user who can view this private message.
